description: This file defines an Android activity called RotationVectorDemo that demonstrates the use of the rotation vector sensor in conjunction with OpenGL ES to render a rotating cube. It manages sensor registration, OpenGL rendering, and a nested Cube class for object rendering, making it a central demo class for sensor and graphics integration.

classes.name: RotationVectorDemo
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating sensor usage and OpenGL rendering of a cube rotating based on device orientation.

classes.name: MyRenderer
classes.description: Inner class implementing GLSurfaceView.Renderer and SensorEventListener to handle rendering and sensor data processing.

classes.name: Cube
classes.description: Inner class within MyRenderer responsible for defining and drawing a 3D cube object.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor manager and sets up the GLSurfaceView and renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts sensor updates and resumes OpenGL rendering when activity gains focus.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops sensor updates and pauses OpenGL rendering when activity loses focus.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Registers the sensor listener for the rotation vector sensor.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Processes rotation vector sensor data and updates the rotation matrix used in rendering.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears the screen and draws the cube with the current rotation matrix.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts viewport and projection matrix on surface size change.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings, e.g., disables dithering and sets background color.

methods.name: Cube
methods.description: Constructs vertex, color, and index buffers for a cube and handles its drawing.
